description: Read-only keyword search across every plan, limit, rate, free tier, overage rule and gotcha in all datasets. Best first call for a question like "Cursor Pro requests per month", "Retell cost per minute" or "Gemini API free tier RPM". Returns `query`, `relaxed` (true when fewer than all words matched), `total`, `shown` and `rows`, each with `type` (plan, limit, rate, free, overage, unit or gotcha), `tool`, `tool_id`, `dataset`, `plan` and/or `metric`, `value`, `unit`, `published`, vendor `quote`, `sourceUrl`, `checked` date and `page`. Matching is case-insensitive on whole words; words that name a product must all match, other words are matched strictly first and then relaxed to at least half of them. At most `limit` rows (default 20, max 50), ranked by match quality; no pagination. Returns an empty `rows` array, not an error, when nothing matches; then try list_tools to find the product id and call get_tool.

dataset.description: Dataset id to narrow the search to. One of: ai-plans, usage, email-sending, llm-apis, media, plans-new, scraping-proxies, search-apis, voice. Omit to cover every dataset.

query.description: Plain words: vendor, plan and metric, e.g. "cursor pro requests" or "vapi per minute". No operators.
